reactionroles.label: Reaction roles
reactionroles.description: Assigns roles when members react to a message. The bot adds one reaction per role, DraftBot-style.

feedback.disabled: ❌ This module is disabled on this server.
feedback.cannotAssign: ⚠️ I can't manage this role (missing « Manage Roles » or role above mine).

g0.label: ⚙️ Panel
g0.description: After any change, republish the panel with the “Publish” button.

channelId.label: Panel channel
channelId.help: The channel the role menu is posted in. The menu does not appear on its own: once the channel is chosen, send it with the « Publish panel » button.

title.label: Title
title.help: The menu's title. Changing it does nothing to an already published menu until it is republished.

description.label: Description
description.help: The text under the title. This is where you explain what the offered roles are for — otherwise members click buttons without knowing what they do.

roles.label: Roles
roles.help: One button per row, 25 at most: clicking grants the role, clicking again removes it. The bot must be able to grant them — they have to sit BELOW its own role in the hierarchy, otherwise the click fails with an error shown to the member. Do not put privileged roles here: a public button would hand moderation to whoever presses it.
